scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved for all positive baseline center hazards and colonization rates by exact Markov first-step identities and ordered polynomial-coefficient sign roots; finite code tests corroborate only.
scientific_limitations: Closed three-vertex path only; initially all occupied; one patch has its extinction rate halved; no external immigration, environmental correlations or empirical validation. Historic priority incompletely assessed because a relevant 2001 full text was inaccessible.
title: A sharp three-habitat switch in extinction-prevention priorities
